Lazels Piece Finder

Ships set · 5¢ Royal William & 50¢ Bluenose. Photograph a piece (or several) and see which stamp it belongs to.

Loading reference stamps…
For best results
  • Piece face-up (printed side). The backs are plain brushed metal and look the same on both stamps, so a back can't tell them apart.
  • Put the piece on your black mat (any plain dark surface).
  • Fill the frame: get as close as your camera can still focus. Several pieces at once is fine if they don't touch.
  • Avoid glare. Light from the side works better than directly overhead.
The two stamps
How it works & settings

Everything runs on this device; nothing is uploaded. The app cuts each piece out of your photo, then slides it across both stamps at every rotation and compares the printed pattern. The stamp where the pattern lines up best wins. Mostly-blank silver border pieces look alike on both stamps, so expect "Not sure" on some of those.

Only change piece size if the "where it goes" outline keeps looking clearly bigger or smaller than the real spot. Leave it at 100% otherwise.
